title: HiDream-O1-Image: A Natively Unified Image Generative Foundation Model with Pixel-level Unified Transformer
limitations: MIT code/models, HF ungated. Plain inference uses bundled local weights/tokenizer/processor; optional Gemma4-31B prompt agent requires gate acceptance, optional API can cost money.
